Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das on Constitution Day alleged that he was stopped at the Uttar Pradesh border while travelling to Meerut to pay homage to Dr BR Ambedkar. Sharing the claim on X, Das questioned why he was being prevented from visiting Ambedkar's statue and offering flowers. He asked whether paying tribute to Babasaheb had become a crime in Uttar Pradesh.
